system.description:
When you coyly attempt to learn about someone while you are pretending to be your twin, roll with the questions:

  • Do they love your twin?
  • Is there an ample distraction?

success.value:
Hold 3. You may spend hold one-for-one to ask any of these questions:

  • What moment of intimacy have you and my twin shared?
  • How do you feel about my twin?
  • What do you owe my twin?
  • How could I make you angry at my twin?

partial.value:
Hold 1. You may spend hold one-for-one to ask any of these questions:

  • What moment of intimacy have you and my twin shared?
  • How do you feel about my twin?
  • What do you owe my twin?
  • How could I make you angry at my twin?

failure.label: Miss
failure.value: You show your hand; they realize you aren't who you claim to be.
